title: Compute exact one-species classes using an enabled gcd word and a finite prefix/tail graph
statement: For one-species rational complex-balanced data symmetrize each reaction with its stationary adjoint at half rates, preserving D=Z E. Remove zero jumps; g=gcd{|z-y|}=0 means singleton classes. Extended Euclid constructs a signed-jump word of net+g; order negatives before positives so every pre-step offset s_j<=0. For source y_j, unhalved original/adjoint rate kappa_j*, set beta_j=(kappa_j*/2)c^s_j. At x>=max_j(y_j-s_j), its labelled conductance gamma_j(x)=beta_j*w(x)*(x)_(y_j-s_j)>=beta_j*w(x). Choose a congruent to x0 modulo g above that threshold and ceil(2c). All a+g*N are connected by translated words. Collapse them to one tail node and enumerate the finite congruent prefix below a with all enabled original/adjoint edges. This quotient gives the EXACT initial class: either a finite component or the entire tail plus its connected prefix. Disabled singleton boundaries are preserved; no reachability/normalizer oracle or unbounded search is assumed.
